<script>
    // Mobile functions
    function toggleMobilePanel(panelId) {
        const panel = document.getElementById(panelId);
        if (panel) {
            // Tutup panel lain
            document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-panel.open').forEach(p => {
                if (p.id !== panelId) p.classList.remove('open');
            });
            panel.classList.toggle('open');
        }
    }
    
    // ============================================
    // FUNGSI RESET UNTUK MOBILE (POJOK KANAN BAWAH - URUTAN KE-5)
    // ============================================
    function mobileResetAllFilters() {
        console.log('Mobile Reset All Filters dipanggil');
        
        // 1. Reset search input desktop
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
        if (searchInput) {
            searchInput.value = '';
            if (typeof window.triggerSearch === 'function') {
                window.triggerSearch();
            }
        }
        
        // 2. Reset search input mobile
        const mobileSearchInput = document.getElementById('mobileSearchInput');
        if (mobileSearchInput) {
            mobileSearchInput.value = '';
        }
        
        // 3. Reset filter kategori, jenis, tanggal global
        if (typeof window.filterKategori !== 'undefined') window.filterKategori = 'all';
        if (typeof window.filterJenis !== 'undefined') window.filterJenis = 'all';
        if (typeof window.filterTanggal !== 'undefined') window.filterTanggal = '';
        
        // 4. Reset input tanggal
        const tanggalInput = document.getElementById('tanggalInput');
        if (tanggalInput) tanggalInput.value = '';
        
        // 5. Reset dropdown kategori options
        document.querySelectorAll('#kategoriOptions .filter-option').forEach(opt => {
            opt.classList.remove('selected');
            if (opt.dataset.kategori === 'all') opt.classList.add('selected');
        });
        
        // 6. Reset dropdown jenis options
        document.querySelectorAll('#jenisOptions .filter-option').forEach(opt => {
            opt.classList.remove('selected');
            if (opt.dataset.jenis === 'all') opt.classList.add('selected');
        });
        
        // 7. Reset active class pada filter buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
        
        // 8. Tutup dropdown yang aktif
        if (typeof window.activeFilter !== 'undefined' && window.activeFilter) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById(window.activeFilter);
            if (dropdown) dropdown.classList.remove('active');
            window.activeFilter = null;
        }
        
        // 9. Reset status filter (kondisi aset)
        if (typeof window.currentSta !== 'undefined') window.currentSta = 'all';
        if (typeof window.currentKat !== 'undefined') window.currentKat = 'all';
        if (typeof window.currentJenis !== 'undefined') window.currentJenis = 'all';
        
        // 10. Reset active status di sidebar kondisi
        ['btnStatBaik', 'btnStatRusak', 'btnStatKritis', 'btnStatProses'].forEach(id => {
            const btn = document.getElementById(id);
            if(btn) btn.classList.remove('status-active');
        });
        
        // 11. Reset title status filter
        const statusTitle = document.getElementById('statusFilterTitle');
        if (statusTitle) statusTitle.innerText = "Kondisi Seluruh Aset";
        
        // 12. Reset statLabel
        const statLabel = document.getElementById('statLabel');
        if (statLabel) statLabel.innerText = "Total Seluruh Aset";
        
        // 13. Reset kategori di sidebar
        if (typeof window.renderCategories === 'function') {
            window.renderCategories();
        }
        
        // 14. Reset mobile selects
        const mobileKategori = document.getElementById('mobileKategoriSelect');
        const mobileJenis = document.getElementById('mobileJenisSelect');
        const mobileTanggal = document.getElementById('mobileTanggalInput');
        if (mobileKategori) mobileKategori.value = 'all';
        if (mobileJenis) mobileJenis.value = 'all';
        if (mobileTanggal) mobileTanggal.value = '';
        
        // 15. Tutup semua panel mobile yang terbuka
        const allMobilePanels = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-panel');
        allMobilePanels.forEach(panel => {
            panel.classList.remove('open');
        });
        
        // 16. Render ulang map dengan semua filter reset
        if (typeof window.renderMap === 'function') {
            window.renderMap('all', 'all', 'all');
        } else if (typeof renderMapWithFilters === 'function') {
            renderMapWithFilters();
        } else if (typeof window.renderMapWithExtraFilters === 'function') {
            window.renderMapWithExtraFilters();
        }
    }
    
    function mobileSearch() {
        const val = document.getElementById('mobileSearchInput').value;
        document.getElementById('searchInput').value = val;
        triggerSearch();
        document.getElementById('mobileSearchPanel').classList.remove('open');
    }
    
    function mobileApplyFilters() {
        const kategori = document.getElementById('mobileKategoriSelect').value;
        const jenis = document.getElementById('mobileJenisSelect').value;
        const tanggal = document.getElementById('mobileTanggalInput').value;
        
        if (kategori !== 'all') {
            const opt = document.querySelector('#kategoriOptions .filter-option[data-kategori="' + kategori + '"]');
            if (opt) opt.click();
        } else {
            document.querySelector('#kategoriOptions .filter-option[data-kategori="all"]')?.click();
        }
        
        if (jenis !== 'all') {
            const opt = document.querySelector('#jenisOptions .filter-option[data-jenis="' + jenis + '"]');
            if (opt) opt.click();
        } else {
            document.querySelector('#jenisOptions .filter-option[data-jenis="all"]')?.click();
        }
        
        if (tanggal) {
            document.getElementById('tanggalInput').value = tanggal;
            const event = new Event('change');
            document.getElementById('tanggalInput').dispatchEvent(event);
        }
        
        document.getElementById('mobileFilterPanel').classList.remove('open');
    }
    
    function mobileResetFilters() {
        resetAllFilters();
        document.getElementById('mobileKategoriSelect').value = 'all';
        document.getElementById('mobileJenisSelect').value = 'all';
        document.getElementById('mobileTanggalInput').value = '';
        document.getElementById('mobileFilterPanel').classList.remove('open');
    }
    
    function toggleMobileCategoryList() {
        const list = document.getElementById('mobileCategoryList');
        const arrow = document.getElementById('mobileCategoryArrow');
        if (list.classList.contains('hidden')) {
            list.classList.remove('hidden');
            arrow.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
        } else {
            list.classList.add('hidden');
            arrow.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)';
        }
    }
    
    function updateMobileStats(total, baik, proses, rusak, kritis) {
        const ids = ['mobileTotalAsset', 'mobileBaik', 'mobileProses', 'mobileRusak', 'mobileKritis', 
                     'mobileSidebarTotal', 'mobileSidebarBaik', 'mobileSidebarProses', 'mobileSidebarRusak', 'mobileSidebarKritis'];
        
        if (document.getElementById('mobileTotalAsset')) document.getElementById('mobileTotalAsset').innerText = total;
        if (document.getElementById('mobileBaik')) document.getElementById('mobileBaik').innerText = baik;
        if (document.getElementById('mobileProses')) document.getElementById('mobileProses').innerText = proses;
        if (document.getElementById('mobileRusak')) document.getElementById('mobileRusak').innerText = rusak;
        if (document.getElementById('mobileKritis')) document.getElementById('mobileKritis').innerText = kritis;
        if (document.getElementById('mobileSidebarTotal')) document.getElementById('mobileSidebarTotal').innerText = total;
        if (document.getElementById('mobileSidebarBaik')) document.getElementById('mobileSidebarBaik').innerText = baik;
        if (document.getElementById('mobileSidebarProses')) document.getElementById('mobileSidebarProses').innerText = proses;
        if (document.getElementById('mobileSidebarRusak')) document.getElementById('mobileSidebarRusak').innerText = rusak;
        if (document.getElementById('mobileSidebarKritis')) document.getElementById('mobileSidebarKritis').innerText = kritis;
    }
    
    function populateMobileKategori() {
        const kategoriSelect = document.getElementById('mobileKategoriSelect');
        if (!kategoriSelect || !window.asetDishub) return;
        const kategoris = [...new Set(window.asetDishub.map(a => a.kategori))].sort();
        kategoriSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="all">Semua Kategori</option>';
        kategoris.forEach(kat => {
            const opt = document.createElement('option');
            opt.value = kat;
            opt.textContent = kat;
            kategoriSelect.appendChild(opt);
        });
    }
    
    function updateMobileJenis() {
        const kategori = document.getElementById('mobileKategoriSelect').value;
        const jenisSelect = document.getElementById('mobileJenisSelect');
        if (!jenisSelect || !window.asetDishub) return;
        let jenisList = [];
        if (kategori === 'all') {
            jenisList = [...new Set(window.asetDishub.map(a => a.jenis))].sort();
        } else {
            jenisList = [...new Set(window.asetDishub.filter(a => a.kategori === kategori).map(a => a.jenis))].sort();
        }
        jenisSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="all">Semua Jenis</option>';
        jenisList.forEach(jen => {
            const opt = document.createElement('option');
            opt.value = jen;
            opt.textContent = jen;
            jenisSelect.appendChild(opt);
        });
    }
    
    function populateMobileCategoryList() {
        const container = document.getElementById('mobileCategoryList');
        if (!container || !window.sidebarCats) return;
        
        const kategoriIcons = {
            'Penerangan Jalan Umum (PJU)': 'fa-lightbulb',
            'Perlengkapan Jalan': 'fa-triangle-exclamation',
            'Fasilitas Lalu Lintas': 'fa-traffic-light',
            'Pengendalian dan Pengawasan': 'fa-video',
            'Prasarana Transportasi': 'fa-bus'
        };
        
        container.innerHTML = window.sidebarCats.map(cat => {
            const iconClass = kategoriIcons[cat.kategori] || 'fa-map-marker-alt';
            const escapedCat = cat.kategori.replace(/'/g, "\\'");
            return `<div onclick="window.selectCategory('${escapedCat}'); document.getElementById('mobileSidebarPanel').classList.remove('open');" class="flex justify-between items-center py-2 px-3 bg-slate-50/50 rounded-md border border-transparent hover:border-slate-200 cursor-pointer transition-all">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <i class="fas ${iconClass} text-indigo-500 kat-icon"></i>
                            <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-600">${cat.kategori}</span>
                        </div>
                        <span class="text-[11px] font-black text-slate-800">${cat.total_jenis} Jenis</span>
                    </div>`;
        }).join('');
    }
    
    // ============================================
    // FILTER DROPDOWN FUNCTIONS
    // ============================================
    let activeFilter = null;
    
    function toggleFilter(filterId) {
        const dropdown = document.getElementById(filterId);
        if (!dropdown) return;
        
        if (activeFilter === filterId) {
            dropdown.classList.remove('active');
            activeFilter = null;
        } else {
            if (activeFilter) {
                const prevDropdown = document.getElementById(activeFilter);
                if (prevDropdown) prevDropdown.classList.remove('active');
            }
            dropdown.classList.add('active');
            activeFilter = filterId;
        }
    }
    
    document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
        if (!event.target.closest('.filter-item')) {
            if (activeFilter) {
                const dropdown = document.getElementById(activeFilter);
                if (dropdown) dropdown.classList.remove('active');
                activeFilter = null;
            }
        }
    });
    
    let filterKategori = 'all';
    let filterJenis = 'all';
    let filterTanggal = '';
    
    function checkTanggalFilter(tanggalObj) {
        if (!filterTanggal) return true;
        if (!tanggalObj) return false;
        
        const tanggalStr = tanggalObj.toLocaleDateString('en-CA');
        return tanggalStr === filterTanggal;
    }
    
    function checkAllFilters(aset) {
        if (filterKategori !== 'all' && aset.kategori !== filterKategori) return false;
        if (filterJenis !== 'all' && aset.jenis !== filterJenis) return false;
        if (!checkTanggalFilter(aset.tgl_buat_obj)) return false;
        return true;
    }
    
    function renderMapWithFilters() {
        if (window.renderMapWithExtraFilters) window.renderMapWithExtraFilters();
    }
    
    // ============================================
    // FUNGSI RESET ALL FILTERS YANG BENAR-BENAR BEKERJA
    // ============================================
    function resetAllFilters() {
        console.log('resetAllFilters dipanggil');
        
        // 1. Reset filter kategori, jenis, tanggal
        filterKategori = 'all';
        filterJenis = 'all';
        filterTanggal = '';
        
        // 2. Reset input tanggal
        const tanggalInput = document.getElementById('tanggalInput');
        if (tanggalInput) tanggalInput.value = '';
        
        // 3. Reset dropdown kategori options (pilih "Semua Kategori")
        document.querySelectorAll('#kategoriOptions .filter-option').forEach(opt => {
            opt.classList.remove('selected');
            if (opt.dataset.kategori === 'all') opt.classList.add('selected');
        });
        
        // 4. Reset dropdown jenis options (pilih "Semua Jenis")
        document.querySelectorAll('#jenisOptions .filter-option').forEach(opt => {
            opt.classList.remove('selected');
            if (opt.dataset.jenis === 'all') opt.classList.add('selected');
        });
        
        // 5. Reset active class pada filter buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
        
        // 6. Tutup dropdown yang aktif
        if (activeFilter) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById(activeFilter);
            if (dropdown) dropdown.classList.remove('active');
            activeFilter = null;
        }
        
        // 7. RESET SEARCH INPUT (CARI ASET)
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
        if (searchInput) {
            searchInput.value = '';
            // Panggil triggerSearch untuk mereset searchQuery di dalam renderMap
            if (typeof window.triggerSearch === 'function') {
                window.triggerSearch();
            }
        }
        
        // 8. RESET STATUS FILTER (Kondisi Aset) - currentSta di dalam DOMContentLoaded
        // Kita perlu memanggil resetHalamanTotal atau langsung reset melalui variable
        if (typeof window.resetHalamanTotal === 'function') {
            // Jangan panggil resetHalamanTotal karena dia akan memanggil resetAllFilters lagi (rekursif)
            // Kita update langsung variable-variable yang diperlukan
            if (typeof window.currentSta !== 'undefined') window.currentSta = 'all';
            if (typeof window.currentKat !== 'undefined') window.currentKat = 'all';
            if (typeof window.currentJenis !== 'undefined') window.currentJenis = 'all';
            
            // Reset active status di sidebar kondisi
            ['btnStatBaik', 'btnStatRusak', 'btnStatKritis', 'btnStatProses'].forEach(id => {
                const btn = document.getElementById(id);
                if(btn) btn.classList.remove('status-active');
            });
            
            // Reset title status filter
            const statusTitle = document.getElementById('statusFilterTitle');
            if (statusTitle) statusTitle.innerText = "Kondisi Seluruh Aset";
            
            // Reset statLabel
            const statLabel = document.getElementById('statLabel');
            if (statLabel) statLabel.innerText = "Total Seluruh Aset";
            
            // Reset kategori di sidebar
            if (typeof window.renderCategories === 'function') {
                window.renderCategories();
            }
        }
        
        // 9. Render ulang map dengan semua filter yang sudah direset
        if (typeof window.renderMap === 'function') {
            window.renderMap('all', 'all', 'all');
        } else if (typeof renderMapWithFilters === 'function') {
            renderMapWithFilters();
        }
    }
    
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const tanggalInput = document.getElementById('tanggalInput');
        if (tanggalInput) {
            tanggalInput.addEventListener('change', function() {
                filterTanggal = this.value;
                renderMapWithFilters();
            });
        }
        
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (window.sidebarCats) populateMobileCategoryList();
        }, 200);
    });

    const MAP_SETTINGS = {
        latitude: {{ $mapConfig['center'][0] }},
        longitude: {{ $mapConfig['center'][1] }},
        defaultZoom: {{ $mapConfig['defaultZoom'] }},
        detailZoom: 18,
        lightMap: "https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png",
        darkMap: "https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png",
        googleRoadmap: "https://mt1.google.com/vt/lyrs=m&x={x}&y={y}&z={z}",
        googleSatellite: "https://mt1.google.com/vt/lyrs=y&x={x}&y={y}&z={z}"
    };

    const kategoriIconMap = {
        'Penerangan Jalan Umum (PJU)': 'fa-lightbulb',
        'Perlengkapan Jalan': 'fa-triangle-exclamation',
        'Fasilitas Lalu Lintas': 'fa-traffic-light',
        'Pengendalian dan Pengawasan': 'fa-video',
        'Prasarana Transportasi': 'fa-bus'
    };

    window.asetDishub = [];
    window.sidebarCats = [];
    let jenisStats = [];

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const rawAssets = @json($assets);
        window.sidebarCats = @json($sidebar_categories);
        jenisStats = @json($jenis_stats);
        
        const statusColors = {
            'Baik': '#16a34a',
            'Rusak': '#fbbf24',
            'Kritis': '#dc2626',
            'Proses Perbaikan': '#3b82f6'
        };

        window.asetDishub = rawAssets.map(a => ({
            id: a.id,
            kategori: a.kategori || "Umum",
            jenis: a.jenis || "",
            nama: a.nama || "",
            alamat: a.alamat || "",
            lat: parseFloat(a.lat),
            lng: parseFloat(a.lng),
            status: a.status,
            warna: statusColors[a.status] || '#64748b',
            foto: a.foto ? `/storage/${a.foto}` : "{{ asset('img/generic.png') }}",
            tgl_buat_str: a.created_at ? new Date(a.created_at).toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }) : '-',
            tgl_buat_obj: a.created_at ? new Date(a.created_at) : null,
            icon_marker: a.icon_marker || (kategoriIconMap[a.kategori] || 'fa-map-marker-alt')
        }));

        populateMobileKategori();
        document.getElementById('mobileKategoriSelect')?.addEventListener('change', updateMobileJenis);
        
        let currentKat = 'all';
        let currentJenis = 'all';
        let currentSta = 'all';
        let searchQuery = '';
        
        // Simpan ke window agar bisa diakses dari resetAllFilters
        window.currentKat = currentKat;
        window.currentJenis = currentJenis;
        window.currentSta = currentSta;
        window.searchQueryGlobal = searchQuery;

        const map = L.map('map', {
            zoomControl: false,
            attributionControl: false,
            maxZoom: 20
        }).setView([MAP_SETTINGS.latitude, MAP_SETTINGS.longitude], MAP_SETTINGS.defaultZoom);
        
        if (typeof initPolygonLayers === 'function') initPolygonLayers(map);

        const baseLayers = {
            "Light Mode": L.tileLayer(MAP_SETTINGS.lightMap, { maxZoom: 20 }),
            "Dark Mode": L.tileLayer(MAP_SETTINGS.darkMap, { maxZoom: 20 }),
            "Google Roadmap": L.tileLayer(MAP_SETTINGS.googleRoadmap, { maxZoom: 20 }),
            "Google Satellite": L.tileLayer(MAP_SETTINGS.googleSatellite, { maxZoom: 20 })
        };
        baseLayers["Light Mode"].addTo(map);

        L.control.layers(baseLayers, null, { position: 'bottomright' }).addTo(map);
        L.control.zoom({ position: 'bottomright' }).addTo(map);

        const markers = L.markerClusterGroup({
            showCoverageOnHover: false,
            zoomToBoundsOnClick: true,
            spiderfyOnMaxZoom: true,
            disableClusteringAtZoom: 13
        });
        map.addLayer(markers);

        const createMarkerIcon = (kat, warna, iconClass) => {
            let bgColor = warna;
            const textColor = '#ffffff';
            const html = `<div class="awesome-marker-wrapper" style="background: ${bgColor}; border-color: ${bgColor};">
                            <i class="fas ${iconClass}" style="color: ${textColor}; font-size: 20px;"></i>
                            <div class="awesome-marker-tail" style="background: ${bgColor};"></div>
                          </div>`;
            return L.divIcon({ html: html, className: '', iconSize: [40, 40], iconAnchor: [20, 40], popupAnchor: [0, -40] });
        };

        const getStatusEmoji = (status) => {
            switch(status) {
                case 'Baik': return '🟢';
                case 'Rusak': return '🟡';
                case 'Kritis': return '🔴';
                case 'Proses Perbaikan': return '🔵';
                default: return '⚪';
            }
        };

        window.renderMapWithExtraFilters = function() {
            renderMap(currentKat, currentJenis, currentSta);
        };

        window.renderMap = function(kat = currentKat, jenis = currentJenis, sta = currentSta) {
            currentKat = kat;
            currentJenis = jenis;
            currentSta = sta;
            
            // Update window variables
            window.currentKat = currentKat;
            window.currentJenis = currentJenis;
            window.currentSta = currentSta;
            window.searchQueryGlobal = searchQuery;
            
            markers.clearLayers();
            let stats = { total: 0, baik: 0, rusak: 0, kritis: 0, proses: 0 };

            window.asetDishub.forEach(aset => {
                const matchKat = (currentKat === 'all' || aset.kategori === currentKat);
                const matchJenis = (currentJenis === 'all' || aset.jenis === currentJenis);
                const matchSta = (currentSta === 'all' || aset.status === currentSta);
                const matchSearch = (searchQuery === '' || `${aset.nama} ${aset.alamat}`.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()));
                const matchFilters = checkAllFilters(aset);

                if (matchKat && matchJenis && matchFilters) {
                    if (aset.status === 'Baik') stats.baik++;
                    else if (aset.status === 'Rusak') stats.rusak++;
                    else if (aset.status === 'Kritis') stats.kritis++;
                    else if (aset.status === 'Proses Perbaikan') stats.proses++;
                    stats.total++;

                    if (matchSta && matchSearch && aset.lat && aset.lng && !isNaN(aset.lat) && !isNaN(aset.lng)) {
                        const m = L.marker([aset.lat, aset.lng], { icon: createMarkerIcon(aset.kategori, aset.warna, aset.icon_marker) });
                        m.bindPopup(`<div class="flex flex-col w-full bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden border border-gray-100" style="min-width: 300px;"><div class="relative h-44 overflow-hidden bg-gray-100"><img src="${aset.foto}" class="w-full h-full object-cover" onerror="this.src='{{ asset('img/generic.png') }}'"></div><div class="p-5 flex flex-col gap-4"><div><div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5"><span class="text-[9px] font-black text-gray-400 tracking-wider">Nama Aset</span></div><h4 class="text-base font-black text-gray-900 leading-tight">${aset.nama}</h4></div><div><div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5"><i class="fas fa-tag text-indigo-400 text-[10px]"></i><span class="text-[9px] font-black text-gray-400 tracking-wider">Kategori & Jenis</span></div><div class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap"><div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-50 rounded-xl"><i class="fas ${aset.icon_marker} text-indigo-500 text-xs"></i><span class="text-[11px] font-bold text-indigo-700">${aset.kategori}</span></div><span class="text-gray-300 text-xs">›</span><span class="text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-600 bg-gray-100 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg">${aset.jenis}</span></div></div><div><div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5"><i class="fas fa-chart-line text-indigo-400 text-[10px]"></i><span class="text-[9px] font-black text-gray-400 tracking-wider">Status Kondisi</span></div><div class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border-2 inline-flex items-center gap-2" style="border-color: ${aset.warna}20; background: ${aset.warna}08"><span class="text-base">${getStatusEmoji(aset.status)}</span><span class="text-[11px] font-black tracking-tighter" style="color: ${aset.warna}">${aset.status}</span></div></div><div><div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5"><i class="fas fa-location-dot text-indigo-400 text-[10px]"></i><span class="text-[9px] font-black text-gray-400 tracking-wider">Lokasi Alamat</span></div><p class="text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-700 leading-relaxed bg-gray-50 p-2.5 rounded-xl">${aset.alamat}</p></div><div class="pt-1 border-t border-gray-100"><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><i class="fas fa-calendar-alt text-indigo-400 text-[10px]"></i><span class="text-[9px] font-black text-gray-400 tracking-wider">Tanggal Dibuat</span><span class="text-[10px] font-medium text-gray-600 ml-auto bg-gray-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">${aset.tgl_buat_str}</span></div></div><div class="pt-2"><a href="/admin/assets/${aset.id}" class="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 w-full bg-white text-gray-700 border border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50 hover:border-gray-300 text-xs font-bold py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-all duration-300 shadow-sm"><i class="fas fa-eye text-indigo-500 text-xs"></i> Lihat Detail</a></div></div></div>`);
                        markers.addLayer(m);
                    }
                }
            });

            document.getElementById('statTotalGlobal').innerText = stats.total;
            document.getElementById('statBaik').innerText = stats.baik;
            document.getElementById('statRusak').innerText = stats.rusak;
            document.getElementById('statKritis').innerText = stats.kritis;
            document.getElementById('statProses').innerText = stats.proses;
            
            updateMobileStats(stats.total, stats.baik, stats.proses, stats.rusak, stats.kritis);
        };

        function populateKategoriOptions() {
            const kategoris = [...new Set(window.asetDishub.map(a => a.kategori))].sort();
            const container = document.getElementById('kategoriOptions');
            if (!container) return;
            let html = `<div class="filter-option selected" data-kategori="all">Semua Kategori</div>`;
            kategoris.forEach(kat => { html += `<div class="filter-option" data-kategori="${kat}">${kat}</div>`; });
            container.innerHTML = html;
            container.querySelectorAll('.filter-option').forEach(opt => {
                opt.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    container.querySelectorAll('.filter-option').forEach(o => o.classList.remove('selected'));
                    this.classList.add('selected');
                    filterKategori = this.dataset.kategori;
                    updateJenisOptionsByKategori(filterKategori);
                    renderMapWithFilters();
                    const dropdown = document.getElementById('kategoriFilter');
                    if (dropdown) dropdown.classList.remove('active');
                    activeFilter = null;
                });
            });
        }
        
        function updateJenisOptionsByKategori(kategori) {
            let jenisList = [];
            if (kategori === 'all') {
                jenisList = [...new Set(window.asetDishub.map(a => a.jenis))].sort();
            } else {
                jenisList = [...new Set(window.asetDishub.filter(a => a.kategori === kategori).map(a => a.jenis))].sort();
            }
            const container = document.getElementById('jenisOptions');
            if (!container) return;
            let html = `<div class="filter-option selected" data-jenis="all">Semua Jenis</div>`;
            jenisList.forEach(jenis => { html += `<div class="filter-option" data-jenis="${jenis}">${jenis}</div>`; });
            container.innerHTML = html;
            container.querySelectorAll('.filter-option').forEach(opt => {
                opt.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    container.querySelectorAll('.filter-option').forEach(o => o.classList.remove('selected'));
                    this.classList.add('selected');
                    filterJenis = this.dataset.jenis;
                    renderMapWithFilters();
                    const dropdown = document.getElementById('jenisFilter');
                    if (dropdown) dropdown.classList.remove('active');
                    activeFilter = null;
                });
            });
        }

        window.selectJenis = (jenisName) => {
            currentJenis = jenisName;
            const kategoriDariJenis = jenisStats.find(j => j.jenis === jenisName)?.kategori || currentKat;
            document.getElementById('currentCategoryTitle').innerText = kategoriDariJenis + ' / ' + jenisName;
            const asetList = window.asetDishub.filter(a => a.jenis === jenisName);
            const container = document.getElementById('listContent');
            if (container) {
                container.innerHTML = asetList.map(aset => `<div onclick="window.selectAset(${aset.id})" class="flex justify-between items-center p-3 hover:bg-white rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition-all border border-transparent hover:border-indigo-100 group"><div class="flex items-center gap-3"><i class="fas ${aset.icon_marker} text-indigo-400 text-xs w-4"></i><div class="flex flex-col"><span class="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-800 group-hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors">${aset.nama}</span><span class="text-[9px] text-gray-400">${aset.alamat.substring(0, 40)}${aset.alamat.length > 40 ? '...' : ''}</span></div></div><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style="background: ${aset.warna}"></span></div></div>`).join('');
                if (asetList.length === 0) container.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center text-gray-400 text-xs py-8">Tidak ada aset dalam jenis ini</div>`;
            }
            renderMap(currentKat, jenisName, currentSta);
        };
        
        window.selectAset = (asetId) => {
            const aset = window.asetDishub.find(a => a.id === asetId);
            if (aset) {
                map.setView([aset.lat, aset.lng], 18);
                markers.eachLayer(layer => {
                    if (layer.getLatLng && layer.getLatLng().lat === aset.lat && layer.getLatLng().lng === aset.lng) layer.openPopup();
                });
            }
        };

        window.selectCategory = (catName) => {
            currentKat = catName;
            currentJenis = 'all';
            document.getElementById('statLabel').innerText = catName;
            document.getElementById('listBreadcrumb').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('currentCategoryTitle').innerText = catName;
            const filtered = jenisStats.filter(j => j.kategori === catName);
            const container = document.getElementById('listContent');
            if (container) {
                container.innerHTML = filtered.map(j => `<div onclick="selectJenis('${j.jenis.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')" class="flex justify-between items-center p-3 hover:bg-white rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition-all border border-transparent hover:border-indigo-100"><span class="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-600">${j.jenis}</span><span class="bg-gray-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-black text-gray-900">${j.total_titik}</span></div>`).join('');
            }
            
            // Update mobile category list also
            if (window.sidebarCats) populateMobileCategoryList();
            
            renderMap(catName, 'all', currentSta);
        };

        window.renderCategories = function() {
            const container = document.getElementById('listContent');
            if (!container) return;
            document.getElementById('listBreadcrumb').classList.add('hidden');
            container.innerHTML = window.sidebarCats.map(cat => {
                const iconClass = kategoriIconMap[cat.kategori] || 'fa-map-marker-alt';
                const escapedCat = cat.kategori.replace(/'/g, "\\'");
                return `<div onclick="selectCategory('${escapedCat}')" class="flex justify-between items-center p-3 hover:bg-white rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition-all border border-transparent hover:border-indigo-100 hover:shadow-sm group">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                                <i class="fas ${iconClass} text-indigo-500 kat-icon"></i>
                                <span class="text-[11px] font-black text-gray-700 group-hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors">${cat.kategori}</span>
                            </div>
                            <span class="text-[9px] font-bold text-gray-400 bg-gray-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">${cat.total_jenis} Jenis</span>
                        </div>`;
            }).join('');
            
            // Also update mobile category list
            if (window.sidebarCats) populateMobileCategoryList();
        };

        window.resetToCategories = () => {
            currentKat = 'all';
            currentJenis = 'all';
            document.getElementById('statLabel').innerText = "Total Seluruh Aset";
            renderCategories();
            renderMap('all', 'all', currentSta);
        };

        window.triggerSearch = () => {
            searchQuery = document.getElementById('searchInput').value;
            window.searchQueryGlobal = searchQuery;
            renderMap();
        };

        window.filterByStatus = (status) => {
            if(currentSta === status) {
                currentSta = 'all';
                ['btnStatBaik', 'btnStatRusak', 'btnStatKritis', 'btnStatProses'].forEach(id => {
                    const btn = document.getElementById(id);
                    if(btn) btn.classList.remove('status-active');
                });
                document.getElementById('statusFilterTitle').innerText = "Kondisi Seluruh Aset";
            } else {
                currentSta = status;
                ['btnStatBaik', 'btnStatRusak', 'btnStatKritis', 'btnStatProses'].forEach(id => {
                    const btn = document.getElementById(id);
                    if(btn) btn.classList.remove('status-active');
                });
                document.getElementById('statusFilterTitle').innerText = "Filter: " + status;
                const activeBtnId = { 'Baik': 'btnStatBaik', 'Rusak': 'btnStatRusak', 'Kritis': 'btnStatKritis', 'Proses Perbaikan': 'btnStatProses' }[status];
                const activeBtn = document.getElementById(activeBtnId);
                if(activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('status-active');
            }
            window.currentSta = currentSta;
            renderMap(currentKat, currentJenis, currentSta);
        };

        window.resetHalamanTotal = () => {
            searchQuery = '';
            window.searchQueryGlobal = '';
            document.getElementById('searchInput').value = '';
            currentSta = 'all';
            ['btnStatBaik', 'btnStatRusak', 'btnStatKritis', 'btnStatProses'].forEach(id => {
                const btn = document.getElementById(id);
                if(btn) btn.classList.remove('status-active');
            });
            currentKat = 'all';
            currentJenis = 'all';
            document.getElementById('statLabel').innerText = "Total Seluruh Aset";
            document.getElementById('statusFilterTitle').innerText = "Kondisi Seluruh Aset";
            
            // Update window variables
            window.currentSta = currentSta;
            window.currentKat = currentKat;
            window.currentJenis = currentJenis;
            
            renderCategories(); 
            if (typeof resetMapView === 'function') resetMapView(); 
            renderMap('all', 'all', 'all'); 
        };

        document.getElementById('btnToggleList').addEventListener('click', () => {
            const container = document.getElementById('assetListContainer');
            const arrow = document.getElementById('arrowIcon');
            const isOpen = container.style.maxHeight !== '0px' && container.style.maxHeight;
            container.style.maxHeight = isOpen ? '0px' : '400px';
            arrow.style.transform = isOpen ? 'rotate(0deg)' : 'rotate(180deg)';
        });

        populateKategoriOptions();
        updateJenisOptionsByKategori('all');
        renderCategories();
        renderMap();
    });
</script>
@endsection

    $this->comment(Inspiring::quote());

<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

use App\Http\Controllers\Petugas\TugasController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Admin\UserManagementController;

// --- HALAMAN LAMA / LEGACY (OPSIONAL) ---

Route::get('/map-view', [DashboardController::class, 'index'])->name('dashboard');
Route::get('/api/asets-map', [AsetApiController::class, 'getAllAssets'])->name('api.asets.map');


// --- AREA TERPROTEKSI (WAJIB LOGIN) ---
Route::middleware(['auth'])->group(function () {

    // Redireksi Dinamis untuk URL /dashboard umum
    Route::get('/dashboard', function() {
        if (Auth::user()->role === 'kadis') return redirect()->route('kadis.dashboard');
        return redirect()->route('admin.dashboard');
    });

    // --- SISTEM NOTIFIKASI (Global untuk semua user login) ---
    Route::get('/notifications/{id}/read', function ($id) {
        $notification = Auth::user()->notifications()->findOrFail($id);
        $notification->markAsRead();
        return redirect($notification->data['url'] ?? route('dashboard'));
    })->name('notifications.read');

    // Route untuk Pengaturan Profil (Bisa diakses Admin & Petugas)
    Route::get('/admin/settings', [ProfileController::class, 'index'])->name('settings.index');
    Route::put('/admin/settings/update', [ProfileController::class, 'update'])->name('settings.update');
    Route::post('/admin/settings/update-foto', [ProfileController::class, 'updateFoto'])->name('settings.updateFoto');

    // Route Detail Maintenance (Akses Admin & Seksi)
    Route::get('/admin/maintenance/{id}/detail', [MaintenanceController::class, 'show'])
        ->middleware('role:admin,seksi')
        ->name('admin.maintenance.show');

    // --- FITUR BERSAMA: ADMIN & KADIS ---
    Route::middleware('role:admin,kadis')->group(function () {
        // GIS Monitoring
        Route::get('/admin/gis', [ManajemenController::class, 'gis'])->name('gis.index');
        
        // List Aset & Export
        Route::get('/admin/assets/list', [AssetController::class, 'list'])->name('assets.list');
        Route::get('/admin/assets/{id}', [AssetController::class, 'show'])->name('assets.show');
        Route::get('/admin/assets/export-excel', [AssetController::class, 'exportExcel'])->name('assets.export');
        Route::get('/admin/assets/export-pdf', [AssetController::class, 'exportPdf'])->name('assets.pdf');
    });

    // --- AREA KHUSUS SUPER ADMIN ---
    Route::prefix('admin')->middleware('role:admin')->group(function () {
        
        // Dashboard Admin
        Route::get('/dashboard', [DashboardController::class, 'index'])->name('admin.dashboard');
        
        // Map Settings
        Route::get('/map-settings', [ManajemenController::class, 'mapSettings'])->name('admin.map.settings');
        Route::post('/map-settings/update', [ManajemenController::class, 'updateMapSettings'])->name('admin.map.settings.update');

        // --- MANAJEMEN USER (CRUD) ---
        Route::get('/users', [UserManagementController::class, 'index'])->name('admin.users.index');
        Route::post('/users/store', [UserManagementController::class, 'store'])->name('admin.users.store');
        Route::get('/users/{id}/settings', [UserManagementController::class, 'settings'])->name('admin.users.settings');
        Route::put('/users/{id}', [UserManagementController::class, 'update'])->name('admin.users.update');
        Route::get('/users/{id}/edit', [UserManagementController::class, 'edit'])->name('admin.users.edit');
        Route::delete('/users/{id}', [UserManagementController::class, 'destroy'])->name('admin.users.destroy');
        Route::patch('/users/{id}/toggle-status', [UserManagementController::class, 'toggleStatus'])->name('admin.users.toggle');

        // --- MANAJEMEN ASSETS (Hanya Admin yang bisa Tambah/Edit/Hapus) ---
        Route::get('/assets', [AssetController::class, 'index'])->name('assets.index');
        Route::get('/assets/create', [AssetController::class, 'create'])->name('admin.assets.create');
        Route::post('/assets/store', [AssetController::class, 'store'])->name('assets.store');
        Route::get('/assets/{id}/edit', [AssetController::class, 'edit'])->name('assets.edit');
        Route::put('/assets/{id}', [AssetController::class, 'update'])->name('assets.update');
        Route::delete('/assets/{id}', [AssetController::class, 'destroy'])->name('assets.destroy');

        // --- KATEGORI & TIPE ASSET ---
        Route::get('/categories', [ManajemenController::class, 'categories'])->name('categories.index');
        Route::get('/assets-types', [ManajemenController::class, 'assetTypes'])->name('assets-types.index');

        // --- MODUL TIKET, PENGADUAN & VALIDASI ---
        Route::get('/laporan', [LaporanController::class, 'adminIndex'])->name('admin.laporan.index');
        Route::get('/tiket', [PengaduanController::class, 'index'])->name('admin.tiket.index');
        Route::get('/pengaduan', [PengaduanController::class, 'index'])->name('admin.pengaduan.index');
        Route::get('/pengaduan/detail/{id}', [PengaduanController::class, 'show'])->name('admin.pengaduan.show');
        Route::post('/pengaduan/validate/{id}', [PengaduanController::class, 'validateLaporan'])->name('admin.pengaduan.validate');
        Route::patch('/pengaduan/update-status/{id}', [PengaduanController::class, 'updateStatus'])->name('admin.pengaduan.update-status');
        Route::post('/pengaduan/selesaikan/{id}', [PengaduanController::class, 'selesaikan'])->name('admin.pengaduan.selesaikan');

        // --- MODUL PENUGASAN ---
        Route::get('/penugasan/{id}', [PenugasanController::class, 'index'])->name('admin.penugasan.index');
        Route::post('/penugasan/{id}/assign', [PenugasanController::class, 'assignTask'])->name('admin.penugasan.assign');
        Route::post('/penugasan/{id}/update', [PenugasanController::class, 'updateProgress'])->name('admin.penugasan.update');

        // --- MODUL MAINTENANCE ---
        Route::get('/maintenance', [MaintenanceController::class, 'index'])->name('admin.maintenance');
        Route::get('/maintenance/list', [MaintenanceController::class, 'index'])->name('admin.maintenance.index'); 
        Route::get('/maintenance/create', [MaintenanceController::class, 'create'])->name('admin.maintenance.create');
        Route::post('/maintenance/store', [MaintenanceController::class, 'store'])->name('admin.maintenance.store');
        Route::get('/maintenance/{id}/edit', [MaintenanceController::class, 'edit'])->name('admin.maintenance.edit');
        Route::put('/maintenance/{id}', [MaintenanceController::class, 'update'])->name('admin.maintenance.update');
        Route::patch('/maintenance/{id}/update-status', [MaintenanceController::class, 'updateStatus'])->name('admin.maintenance.updateStatus');
        
        // --- MODUL LAPORAN PETUGAS & ACTIVITY LOG ---
        Route::get('/laporan-petugas', [LaporanPetugasController::class, 'create'])->name('laporan.petugas.create');
        Route::get('/activity', [ActivityController::class, 'index'])->name('admin.activity.index');
    });

    // --- AREA KHUSUS SEKSI / PETUGAS LAPANGAN ---
    Route::prefix('admin/petugas')->middleware('role:seksi')->group(function () {
        Route::get('/tugas-tersedia', [TugasController::class, 'tersedia'])->name('petugas.tersedia');
        Route::get('/tugas-selesai', [TugasController::class, 'selesai'])->name('petugas.selesai');
        Route::patch('/update-tugas/{id}', [TugasController::class, 'updateStatus'])->name('petugas.tugas.updateStatus');
    });

    // --- AREA KHUSUS KEPALA DINAS (EKSEKUTIF) ---
    Route::prefix('kadis')->middleware('role:kadis')->group(function () {
        Route::get('/dashboard', [EksekutifController::class, 'index'])->name('kadis.dashboard');
        Route::get('/export-pdf', [EksekutifController::class, 'exportPDF'])->name('eksekutif.export.pdf');
        Route::get('/export-excel', [EksekutifController::class, 'exportExcel'])->name('eksekutif.export.excel');
    });

});
